SELECT f.date, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.reorder_point, f.order_up_to, f.book_on_hand, f.on_order, f.ordered_units,
       ds.units_sold, ds.revenue_inr, ib.book_on_hand_close,
       (SELECT string_agg(s.status, ',' ORDER BY s.audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits s WHERE s.sku=f.sku AND s.audit_ts::date=f.date) AS audits

LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.sku=f.sku AND ds.date=f.date

WHERE f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND f.date >= '2026-06-01' AND f.date < '2026-07-01'

WITH june AS (
  SELECT * FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
), oos AS (
  SELECT date FROM june WHERE units_sold = 0
), bills AS (
  SELECT ts::date d, count(DISTINCT bill_id) n FROM payments.pos_payments
  WHERE ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1
), other_atta AS (
  SELECT pl.bill_ts::date d, count(DISTINCT pl.bill_id) n
  FROM store.pos_lines pl
  WHERE pl.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND pl.bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
    AND pl.sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG')
    AND pl.bill_ts::date IN (SELECT date FROM oos)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM june) AS q1_units,
  (SELECT SUM(revenue_inr) FROM june) AS q1_revenue,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM oos) AS oos_days,
  (SELECT string_agg(date::text, ', ' ORDER BY date) FROM oos) AS oos_dates,
  (SELECT SUM(n) FROM bills WHERE d IN (SELECT date FROM oos)) AS q2_shoppers,
  (SELECT SUM(n) FROM other_atta) AS q2_other_atta_bills,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts>='2026-06-01' AND audit_ts<'2026-07-01') AS audits,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts>='2026-06-01' AND audit_ts<'2026-07-01' AND status='on shelf') AS on_shelf,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM june) AS recorded_days,
  (SELECT round(SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day),2) FROM store.forecasts f JOIN oos o ON o.date=f.date WHERE f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS q4_lost_units,
  (SELECT round(SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day)*265,2) FROM store.forecasts f JOIN oos o ON o.date=f.date WHERE f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS q4_lost_value,
  (SELECT round(SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day),2) FROM store.forecasts f WHERE f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND f.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30') AS month_forecast,
  (SELECT round(SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day)-SUM(j.units_sold),2) FROM store.forecasts f JOIN june j ON j.date=f.date WHERE f.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS month_forecast_minus_actual;

SELECT count(*) AS audits,

-- Q3: on-shelf availability for 5 kg atta in June 2026
SELECT count(*) AS audits,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf') AS on_shelf,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='empty') AS empty,
       round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf')/count(*),1) AS on_shelf_pct,
       string_agg(audit_ts::text||'='||status, ', ' ORDER BY audit_ts) AS audit_detail
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < '2026-07-01';
